steps.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE compact tutorial illustration for the mobile dark-fantasy game shown in the reference screenshot. It will appear beneath a Russian instruction paragraph; the text is rendered separately in the app.
Reference screenshot supplies the actual UI vocabulary: orthographic 3x3 stone board, thin aged-bronze borders, mossy muted green player cells, ochre enemy cells, amber stamina bars, carved ivory gesture arrows. SIMPLIFY these surfaces strongly so the diagram is immediately readable at 300 pixels wide. Keep muted gothic materials and upper-left lighting, with clear warm ivory instructional symbols and strong silhouettes.
Output wide landscape approximately 2:1, 1536x768, genuinely TRANSPARENT PNG RGBA. All space outside the illustrated game components and arrows must be alpha-transparent. No scene background, dark rectangle, backing panel, large outer frame, phone, screenshot chrome, prose, title, labels, logos or watermark. Components themselves remain opaque. Do not reproduce the whole screenshot. Large, sparse composition with about 6% transparent margin. No ornamental clutter.
Diagram: three large cells laid out in one horizontal sequence. Left: a moss-green square player attack tile containing a simple sword angled upward-right. Right: an ochre square enemy attack tile containing a sword angled upward-left. Both tiles point inward with ivory arrows toward the CENTER result cell. Center result cell is larger, split diagonally into green lower-left and ochre upper-right, containing TWO distinguishable crossed swords, one per side. Place a large clean ivory fraction "½" by EACH side of the center cell, exactly two fraction symbols total, to show both attacks deal half damage. No other text, no percentages, no shields, no fire or explosion. Inward arrows and the two fractions must be instantly clear at small size.

references.role: Actual mobile combat screenshot used as UI layout, material and palette reference.
